title: Transistor-level view of a block (chiplet-eda-views-transistor/v1)
description: Names a block's netlist files by relative path and sha256, in listing order, and states what a consumer binds: the top subcircuit as written, whether the netlist holds it as a .subckt card or as the commented **.subckt pair Xschem writes, the top's pins in order with a declared role each, the library subcircuits the netlist instantiates (devices) and the ones it defines besides the top (local_subckts). It stands alone beside its files, paths relative to its own directory, or sits in an eda-views.json record as one transistor_view row plus the spice or cdl rows it names, paths relative to the record. Structural validation only: the reader derives the pins, local_subckts and devices from the files and refuses any difference, refuses a path that resolves outside its root, and refuses a dialect it does not read.

top.description: The top subcircuit's name as the netlist writes it. A consumer binds the reader's mapped top, never this value.

pins.description: The top's pins in its order. Roles are declared, not derived.

file.description: A relative POSIX path with no .. component.
